messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 502/504 error rate detected on api-gateway-edge at 2026-03-14T09:12:25Z. current rate 8.7% (5m avg 7.9%). paging @marco (oncall), @sasha, @tim -- see /monitoring/gateway/errors.
marco (oncall): seeing it in dashboards, spikes across eu & us-east. latency also rising. grabbing logs now.
sasha: I can join, pulling recent proxy logs from edge-01..edge-04.
tim: oncall notebook: initial hypothesis: upstream connection resets to inference-backend-frontend group. Nginx 502s in the access logs.
anika: is there a deploy recently? I don't see any deploys in the last 30m in deploy-bot.
marco (oncall): no deploys. K8s events show some node OOMs earlier but nodes recovered. autoscaler shows scale events at 09:05.
jordan: digging into loadbalancer -> gateway upstream health: several upstreams returning 502/504 with tcp_reset in logs. Sample: ```
[2026-03-14T09:11:58Z] edge-02 upstream inference-frontend/10.2.5.12:502 tcp_reset
[2026-03-14T09:12:03Z] edge-02 upstream inference-frontend/10.2.5.13:504 timeout
```
marco (oncall): interesting — that looks like backend timeouts and resets. Is the backend experiencing high CPU or memory?
sasha: backend pod metrics show KV cache miss storms + CPU at 92% on model-serving-pool-3 in us-east. Long GC cycles on process logs around 09:10.
tim: could be a resource hotspot caused by a sudden traffic pattern hitting long-context requests. Can we shed or route traffic?
anika: propose immediate mitigations: 1) enable 10s extended timeout on the gateway for model-inference routes to reduce 504s from slow responses, 2) enable failover routing to us-west for a subset of traffic, 3) reduce max_tokens for guest routes via dynamic throttling. Thoughts?
jordan: agree with failover + targeted timeout increase for a short window. but increasing timeout may increase client perceived latency — prefer to route instead.
marco (oncall): taking action: 1) add route override for app-tier=plg to route 30% traffic to us-west (manual traffic-split), 2) cordon and restart the two worst-performing backend pods (10.2.5.12, .13) after collecting core dumps, 3) enable temporary rate-limit at gateway for anonymous API keys to 10 rps.
sasha: running `kubectl exec -n model-serving model-frontend-12 -- journalctl -u model.service --since "10m"` — collecting logs now.
tim: note: `statuspage` should be updated with initial notice: "We are investigating increased gateway errors for some API requests; mitigation in progress." @status-bot can you post?
status-bot: STATUSPAGE: posted incident "Partial API errors (502/504) — investigating" with impacted regions: US-EAST, EU.
anika: FYI customers: 2 enterprise customers hit with failing requests (org: Optima, org: Lexa). CS alerted and prepared workaround: retry/backoff guidance.
marco (oncall): logs show connection reset cause: upstream rejecting connections due to too many open file descriptors on pods. `/proc/sys/fs/file-max` increased but process FD limit unchanged. creating a temporary fix: restart to clear FDs and scale replicas + patch ulimit in next deploy.
jordan: restarted model-frontend-12 & 13; post-restart the 502s on edge-02 dropped by ~60% in the last 20s. metrics: error_rate -> 3.3%.
sasha: rolling restart of model-frontend pool continuing, spinning up extra replica in us-east to absorb traffic.
tim: mitigation checklist: - restarted bad pods (done) - traffic split to us-west (applied) - rate-limits for anonymous keys (applied) - statuspage update (done) - CS notified (done). Anything else?
anika: recommend keeping circuit-breaker on for 10 min and continue monitoring. Prepare RCA notes: root cause likely resource exhaustion (FD leak) in model frontend under a long-tail request pattern.
marco (oncall): handing off to @sasha for post-mitigation observation and RCA assembly. oncall handoff: Marco -> Sasha. Handoff note: initial mitigation executed, error rate reduced from 8.7% -> 2.9% but not fully back to baseline. watch for regressions over next 30m.
sasha: taking over. I'll keep the thread updated and open a follow-up in #eng-runtime for root cause and patch.
marco (oncall): thanks team. will update on-call log and include commands run and pod dumps.
status-bot: STATUSPAGE: updated with "Mitigation in progress — partial recovery observed. Next update in 30 minutes."
sasha: observed slow error tail in EU region; keeping routing split for now. starting a short-lived packet capture on edge-02 to confirm reset patterns.
jordan: saved core dumps and uploaded to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1943212345/ — link: https://s3.redwood/incident-dumps/1943212345.
anika: opened ticket INF-5024 to track FD leak fix and config change for ulimit in helm chart.
sasha: last check (09:21:00Z) error rate 2.1% and steady. leaving rate-limits in place for 15 more minutes, then gradually revert if stable.
marco (oncall): closing active page. handoff complete. If error rate creeps back over 3% re-alert.
status-bot: STATUSPAGE: resolved -> "Partial service recovery; monitoring. Postmortem and permanent fix in progress."
